scope: paper-only source analysis and production-owner selection

source_baselines.source: wayland text-input unstable v3 protocol copy in qt6-base

measured_source_facts: GNOME Shell creates one IBus input context named gnome-shell and reuses it across ClutterInputFocus changes.
GNOME Shell handles commit-text and delete-surrounding-text as separate callbacks and calls Clutter.InputMethod.commit() and delete_surrounding() independently.
Each current Clutter commit or delete call creates one separate CLUTTER_IM event and calls clutter_event_put().
Each clutter_event_put() acquires and releases the GAsyncQueue lock independently; there is no batch marker spanning delete and commit.
MetaWaylandTextInputFocus defers text-input-v3 done at CLUTTER_PRIORITY_EVENTS + 1 and groups only events seen so far.
Pending done is forcibly flushed on focus reset, an unfiltered key event, and selected button or touch transitions.
A queue sequence of IM_DELETE, unfiltered key or focus reset, IM_COMMIT can therefore expose two text-input-v3 done boundaries.
Wayland text-input-v3 requires preedit, delete and commit events to remain pending until one done event applies them in the specified order.
Qt 6 text-input-v3 stores delete and commit as pending state and creates one QInputMethodEvent replacement only from done().
The current Lay managed GUI path commits the first printable character while the active-composition buffer is empty, so normal Space correction usually targets already committed text.

rejected_designs.design: GNOME Shell calls existing Clutter delete and commit methods synchronously
rejected_designs.reason: the methods still enqueue two separately locked events and an intervening event can flush done
the executable is absent, the route is inactive, and Mutter 50.1 source does not expose that owner for the observed GNOME path
it reduces committed-tail edits but cannot by itself cover post-commit double-Shift rollback or later corrections

selected_design.name: GNOME Shell profile bridge plus synchronous Mutter text-input-v3 composite frame
selected_design.profile_owner: the current ClutterInputFocus through a typed Mutter virtual capability, not a client-name or product heuristic
submission_contract: validate exact focus lineage, native transaction epoch, surrounding snapshot and complete canonical vector before output
complete any prior non-mutating pending done boundary before the new frame
emit preedit clear when required, delete, commit, optional new preedit and exactly one done without returning to the main loop
return SubmittedAtomic only after done is queued; otherwise RefusedZeroEffect
finish a refused event through focus-bound synchronous native replay before starting the next RPC
remove delete authority for password, PIN, hidden, sensitive and terminal content profiles
never retry after uncertain submission and never fall through to legacy delete plus commit
